scripts.test:e2e:db:reset: rm -rf .wrangler/e2e-state && wrangler d1 migrations apply todai-league --local --persist-to .wrangler/e2e-state
scripts.test:e2e:server: pnpm test:e2e:db:reset && pnpm build && wrangler dev --port 4173 --persist-to .wrangler/e2e-state
scripts.check: pnpm run gen && svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json
scripts.check:ci: pnpm run gen:check && svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json
scripts.check:watch: pnpm run gen && svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json --watch
scripts.db:migrate:deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --config wrangler.jsonc --remote
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply todai-league-staging --config wrangler.staging.jsonc --remote
scripts.db:migrate:prod: wrangler d1 migrations apply todai-league --config wrangler.jsonc --remote
scripts.auth:schema: pnpm dlx auth@latest generate --config src/lib/server/auth.ts --output src/lib/server/db/auth.schema.ts --yes
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build && pnpm run cf:deploy-worker && pnpm run cf:ensure-secrets && pnpm run db:migrate:deploy && pnpm run cf:deploy-worker

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: Generated automatically on first deploy by scripts/ensure-cloudflare-secrets.mjs. Do not rotate unless you intentionally want to invalidate existing sessions.

BETTER_AUTH_URL.description: Optional. Leave unset to use the request origin automatically. Set only when forcing a canonical auth origin.

BACKUP_WORKER_URL.description: Optional. Public URL for the backup Worker if the backup feature is deployed.

BACKUP_DOWNLOAD_TOKEN.description: Optional. Token used by the backup settings page when the backup Worker is deployed.
